allowed_dispositions_considered.why: The DQ-01 repair is complete and every structural law is satisfied, but 38 of 78 accounts carry no authority-supplied number and remain typed UNBOUND_PENDING_TECHNICAL_ACCEPTANCE. Those are technical values awaiting the broker and selected-reader implementation acceptances. The structure is ready; the values are not. Selecting the unqualified 'ready for independent review' would imply the technical values are settled, which they are not.

allowed_dispositions_considered.rejected_because: Would assert the instrument is ready for review as a complete successor. It is not: 38 accounts are unbound, R9-SEL-03 has no implementation owner for the frozen selected-read budgets, and all seven locators remain unfilled. This disposition is arguably also true, but it understates the pending state, so the more specific disposition was chosen.

No conflict was found. Every value bound traces to an exact artifact@commit:json.path citation. Two apparent tensions were examined and resolved without conflict: (a) SRC26 carries 176 header-prefix bytes alongside 174/332 geometry - these are three distinct accounts, not a contradiction; (b) SRC27's 'exactly one pass' sits beside lower-layer minimums - a workload constraint and access floors are different account classes, and the frozen law says so explicitly.

The structure represents it. The two-stage separation, the ten mandatory separate accounts, non-substitutability of path opens vs reader vs decoder invocations, the measurement-basis requirement and the typed-null discipline are all representable and are represented, as 23 asserted invariants confirm.
